name: astrolabe
description: Spec Kit progress and usage governance for Claude Code: a phase rail above the prompt, the next command in the prompt hint, the current task on the spinner, a /astrolabe pane, toasts, update buttons, and a status entry with your usage window.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Where Astrolabe draws: minimal (status line only), compact (status, band, hint, spinner and the drift alarm) or full (compact plus phase toasts and the pane opening by itself on wide screens)

flavor.title: Flavor
flavor.description: Catppuccin flavor for the band colors

checkUpdates.title: Check for updates
checkUpdates.description: Once a day, check gstack, the Spec Kit CLI, this project's Spec Kit skills and Astrolabe for updates (one GitHub API call), and offer a button to install each

governUsage.title: Govern usage
governUsage.description: Keep subagent fan-out under the 5-hour and weekly windows: cap at 60%, hold new subagents from 80%, pause from 88% and resume after the reset

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Icons in the footer, band and pane: auto (Nerd Font glyphs in the terminal, emoji in the Desktop app and elsewhere), nerd, emoji or ascii

askOnLimit.title: Ask before holding or pausing
askOnLimit.description: When the governor queues a subagent or pauses Claude, ask you with a list of answers (queue, run now, lift for a while); the cautious default applies at once, and your answer changes it
